prd.description: Generate a product requirements document from a brief. Use when user wants to define what they're building, create a PRD, or plan a product.

research.description: Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and user insights. Use when user wants to research competitors, validate assumptions, or understand a market.

design.description: Create and refine frontend UI components and pages. Use when user wants to build, style, or improve UI elements using the design system.

wireframe.description: Rapidly prototype interactive wireframes and screens. Use when user wants quick low-fi prototypes, screen layouts, or flow mockups.

ship.description: Deploy to Vercel and set up feedback collection. Use when user wants to deploy, ship, publish, or collect user feedback.

figma.description: Pull designs from Figma, extract tokens, translate to code, and sync component mappings. Use when user wants to work with Figma files, inspect designs, or sync components.

design-system.description: Set up or modify the design system: colors, typography, spacing, radius, and component conventions. Use when user wants to change colors, fonts, theme, or audit design consistency.
